_comment: Public GitHub App client ids (ADR 010) — never a secret. `dev` must match OAUTH_CLIENTS.github and GITHUB_APP_INSTALL_URL in src/providers/oauth-clients.ts (tests/github-apps.test.ts checks). build-ext.mjs --store (npm run zip:ext) swaps dev for production in dist/. A production clientId of TODO_OWNER_CLIENT_ID ships store builds without Connect GitHub (token path only).
